title: Edu-MMBias: A Three-Tier Multimodal Benchmark for Auditing Social Bias in Vision-Language Models under Educational Contexts

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated through a three-tier framework measuring cognitive bias (Multimodal Implicit Association Test), affective bias (Affect Misattribution Procedure), and behavioral bias (simulated candidate selection) using generated student images with varying gender attributes.

Evaluated through a three-tier framework measuring cognitive bias (Multimodal Implicit Association Test), affective bias (Affect Misattribution Procedure), and behavioral bias (simulated candidate selection) using generated student images with varying racial attributes.

Evaluated through a three-tier framework measuring cognitive bias (Multimodal Implicit Association Test), affective bias (Affect Misattribution Procedure), and behavioral bias (simulated candidate selection) using generated student images reflecting different income levels (low, middle, high).

Evaluated through a three-tier framework measuring cognitive bias (Multimodal Implicit Association Test), affective bias (Affect Misattribution Procedure), and behavioral bias (simulated candidate selection) using generated student images reflecting varying health conditions (e.g., excellent health, chronic condition).

Evaluated through a three-tier framework measuring cognitive bias (Multimodal Implicit Association Test), affective bias (Affect Misattribution Procedure), and behavioral bias (simulated candidate selection) using generated student images with visual cues implying different hobbies (e.g., academic, artistic, athletic, social).
